Facelift Package in Seoul, South Korea by VG Plastic Surgery

This facelift package at VG Plastic Surgery in Gangnam, Seoul starts at $5,100 and targets jowls, lower-face sagging and loose neck skin.

What is included

  • Consultation with the surgeon and any planned neck work
  • Anesthesia, facility charges and preoperative tests
  • Dressings, routine medication and postoperative reviews
  • Drain or suture removal and interpreter coordination

Not included

Airfare, visas, travel insurance, accommodation, meals and any additional procedures are not part of the package price.

Planning your stay

Plan for about 10–14 days in Seoul, subject to your surgeon's advice and clearance to fly. Bruising typically settles over about two weeks.

The final quote depends on the surgeon's assessment, so ask for the written list of inclusions before you book.
